offline: No internet. What you say is kept here until we’re back.
emptyBody: Say the first commitment the way you think of it, and it lands in your day.
nextStepText: “Study for the exam” is big. Split it into 5 sessions over 5 days?
suggestionNote: This is a suggestion. Nothing has changed yet.
calConnected: Busy times from your phone calendar
settingsNote: Settings, Trust & privacy and the interruption budget are designed in the next round. Activity moves here as a neutral history.
sayItLikeYouThink: Just say it the way you think it
tapToTalk: Tap and talk, or hold while you speak
checkTranscript: This is what we heard. Fix anything.
privacyVoice: Audio is never saved. Only the text is sent, after you check it.
privacyText: The text goes to our server to be understood. We don’t keep it.
nothingBody: We understood the sentence, but there’s nothing to put in your day.
confirmN: {n, plural, =0{Nothing to confirm} one{Confirm # commitment} other{Confirm # commitments}}
readingsBanner: We read this two ways. Pick the right one →
clarifyQ: When do you want to hand in the report?
readingsBody: “Meeting with Sami on Thursday.” Which Thursday?
readingsPrivacy: This sentence went to our server to be read two ways. We don’t keep it after you choose.
rearrangeReason: “{t}” needs an hour, and there’s less than that left before it. Pick what suits you.
toastIntensify: OK. Now half an hour, same time.
exReport: I have to hand in the report
lockedTitle: Today, {n, plural, one{# thing} other{# things}}
progressWords: {d, plural, =0{none of {n} done} other{{d} of {n} done}}
authSubtitle: Sign in so your commitments follow you to any device.
authLegalNote: By continuing you agree to our Terms and Privacy Policy.
authResetBody: Enter your email and we'll send a reset link.
authResetSent: If that email has an account, a reset link is on its way.
authSwitchToSignIn: Already have an account? Sign in
authVerifyBanner: Confirm your email to keep your account recoverable.
authFieldEmailInvalid: That doesn't look like an email address.
authErrorSignIn: That email or password didn't match.
authErrorInvalidEmail: That doesn't look like an email address.
authErrorEmailInUse: That address can't be used for a new account. Try signing in.
authErrorTooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
authErrorNetwork: Can't reach MaybeSitter right now. Check your connection and try again.
errorsNetwork: Can't reach MaybeSitter right now. Check your connection and try again.
errorsServer: Something on our side didn't answer. Try again in a moment.
errorsValidation: That couldn't be saved as written. Check it and try again.
crashBody: Nothing you confirmed was lost. Try again when you’re ready.
errorsConsentRequired: Turn this on in Settings to see suggestions.
errorsQuietMode: Quiet mode is on. Nothing will be suggested until you turn it off.
authErrorNoPlayServices: Google sign-in needs Google Play services. Use email instead.
authErrorAppleUnavailable: Apple sign-in isn't available on this device. Use Google or email.
errorsStaleCommitment: This changed on another device. Here's the latest version.
accountDeleteLede: This is permanent. There is no undo and no grace period.
accountDeleteWhatGoesSignIn: Your sign-in — the account itself is removed, on every device.
accountDeleteWhatGoesData: Everything you have saved with us: commitments, decisions, consents and feedback history.
accountDeleteWhatGoesIntegrations: Anything you connected: calendar access is revoked, and push tokens are removed.
accountDeleteWhatStaysHeading: What is kept for a while
accountDeleteWhatStaysCrash: Crash reports, which are not linked to your account, for 90 days.
accountDeleteWhatStaysBackups: Encrypted database backups, which roll off within 30 days.
accountDeleteWhatStaysReceipt: A deletion receipt with no name, email or account id in it — the proof this happened.
accountDeleteConfirmBody: This deletes your account and everything you have saved. It cannot be undone.
accountDeleteOfflineNote: You're offline. Reconnect to delete your account.
accountDeleteUnavailable: This account can't be deleted from this device. Contact support and we'll do it for you.
accountReauthBody: For your safety we ask again, right before deleting.
accountDeletedBody: Nothing of yours is left on our servers. Keep the receipt below if you ever need proof.
noCommitmentInformational: Nothing to save here. Nothing was added to your day.
noCommitmentGreetingOrChat: Nothing to save here. Write a task or reminder when you're ready.
noCommitmentQuestion: MaybeSitter only saves commitments. It can't answer questions yet.
noCommitmentPastEvent: This looks like something that already happened. Nothing was added.
noCommitmentLowConfidence: Couldn't read a commitment here. Try naming the task and a time.
obWelcomeBody: Say a commitment out loud or type it. MaybeSitter turns it into something you can see, move, or drop on purpose.
obWelcomeCard1: Nothing is saved until you confirm it.
obWelcomeCard2: There is no "overdue". Only active, done, moved, or dropped on purpose.
obWelcomeCard3: You decide what it may use. You can change your mind in Settings.
obConsentLede: Three separate questions. All start off. Nothing is chosen for you.
obAiTitle: Let AI read what you write
obAiWhatIsSent: Sent: what you type or dictate, the date and time, your time zone, and your description of yourself if you give one.
obAiToWhom: To: Google Cloud Vertex AI (Gemini), in the EU.
obAiWhy: Why: to turn your words into reminders and plans.
obAiNotSent: Never sent: your name, email, contacts, calendar, or location.
obAiDeclinedNote: Capture still works. It reads your words with rules instead, and says so.
obRecBody: One suggestion at a time, with a short reason, from your own commitments, deadlines and routine. It never acts for you and nothing goes to a model.
obAnalyticsBody: Counts of what screens are used, with no content and nothing that names you.
obConsentNeedAi: Choose one of the two answers above to continue.
obConsentFailed: Your answers did not reach the server. Nothing was changed.
obConsentChecking: Checking which version of these questions your account has. One moment.
obRoutineTitle: How does your day usually go?
obRoutineSync: Your answers are saved to your account so MaybeSitter can plan your day. You can change or delete them in Settings.
obRoutineReminderFollowUp: Follow up if I do not answer
obRoutineReminderStrong: Be firm about the important ones
obRoutineSaveFailed: Saved on this phone. It will reach your account when you are back online.
obRoutineSaveLost: Nothing was saved. Not to your account, and not on this phone.
obRoutineStorageKept: This phone would not keep a copy of your answers. Your account still has them.
obNotifBody: MaybeSitter can remind you at the times you chose. Your phone will ask before it does — not now, and never during your quiet hours.
aiQuotaUserDaily: You've reached today's AI limit. Your text is safe — try again tomorrow.
aiQuotaTryLater: Too many requests just now. Your text is safe — try again in a moment.
aiServiceUnavailable: AI is busy for everyone right now. Your text is safe — try again later.
aiInputTooLong: That text is too long to analyse. Shorten it and try again.
legalUnavailable: Couldn't open it. The address is {url}
trustLede: What MaybeSitter may do. Every one of these is off until you turn it on, and off again the moment you turn it off.
trustActionFailed: That didn't reach the server. Nothing changed.
trustQuietModeBody: No suggestions at all until you turn this off.
trustCalendarNotConnected: Not connected here. MaybeSitter can add your confirmed commitments to a calendar you choose — see Settings → Calendar.
trustPersonalizationTitle: Notice patterns in when you finish things
trustPersonalizationBody: MaybeSitter may look at the times you finish things and suggest a pattern it sees, like the hours you usually get things done. Nothing is saved unless you keep it. Turning this off stops the suggestions, and your next daily plan stops using patterns you kept.
trustRevokeBody: MaybeSitter stops suggesting and stops learning from you. Your data stays until you delete it.
trustExport: Request a copy of my data
trustExportBody: Not available yet. When it is, you will be able to ask for everything MaybeSitter holds about you.
readinessEnergyBody: Choose 1 to 5. This can shape today's plan, and it stays separate from any wearable or health source.
readinessUnavailable: Can't reach readiness right now. Your plan still works without it.
readinessSaveFailed: That did not save. Try again in a moment.
readinessPrivacyNote: MaybeSitter stores the normalized readiness signal, not raw health samples.
readinessSourceNone: No readiness signal is being used.
notifSoftBody: Something you asked to be reminded about is coming up. Open MaybeSitter to see it.
notifGentleBody: A quiet heads-up before something you chose a time for. It stops as soon as you say you know.
notifQuietBody: Nothing arrives during these hours. A reminder that falls inside them waits until they end.
notifDenied: Your phone is set to show nothing from MaybeSitter. You can change that in phone settings.
notifSaveFailed: That did not save. Try again in a moment.
notifMustBody: How far a reminder may go. Only commitments you marked Must can ever ring.
notifHardExplainBody: Only commitments you marked Must. Your phone rings 10 minutes before they start, even if the app is closed. You can turn it off here any time.
notifMustQuiet: Let Must reminders through quiet hours
notifMustQuietBody: Only the ring 10 minutes before a Must item. Everything else still waits for quiet hours to end.
notifExactDenied: Android may deliver Must reminders a few minutes late. Allow “Alarms & reminders” for exact timing.
notifMustRingDenied: Must items cannot ring because notifications are off for MaybeSitter. You can turn them on in phone settings.
notifMustRingProvisional: Must items cannot ring because this phone only lets MaybeSitter deliver quietly. Allow alerts and sounds in phone settings.
feedbackHistoryEmpty: Nothing yet. Once you accept, move or drop a suggestion, it shows here.
feedbackHistoryUnavailable: Can't reach this right now. Nothing was changed.
memoryDeleteConfirm: Delete this? It cannot be undone.
memoryDeleteAllConfirm: Delete everything? It cannot be undone.
memoryOpen: See all of it, and why
memoryScreenEmpty: It has nothing about you yet.
memoryOriginSurvey: From the questions you answered at the start
memoryOriginDescription: From the way you described yourself
memoryWhyEdited: This replaced a version you changed
memoryWhyNoObservations: Nothing was watched to arrive at this
memoryDeleteAllAlso: This also clears what was learned from what you confirmed.
memorySuggestionsLede: Nothing here is kept unless you keep it.
memorySuggestionFocusWindow: You often finish things between {start} and {end}.
memorySuggestionEvidence: Things you finished in the last {days} days: {total}. In these hours: {matching}.
memoryOriginRule: You kept this when it was suggested
memoryWhyPattern: Read from when you finished things: {start}–{end}
memoryWhyPlanUse: Your daily plan can use these hours when you haven't set focus hours. Delete it and the next plan stops using them.
memoryAdaptiveUnset: Nothing to read it from yet — no activity to sort into a group.
memoryAdaptiveEffect: The group changes only how small a suggested step is; it can make reminders gentler, never stronger.
clarifyAskAction: What would you like to do?
obAboutFailed: Couldn't read that. Nothing was saved.
obAboutManualBody: AI is off, so nothing you write here is sent anywhere. Add anything you want MaybeSitter to remember, one line at a time.
obAboutReviewLede: Nothing is saved yet. Tick only what you want MaybeSitter to remember — you can edit any of it.
obAboutReviewNone: Nothing to suggest from that. You can add things yourself in Settings later.
todayCountOpen: {n, plural, =0{Nothing open} one{# thing open} other{# things open}}
detailsNotFoundBody: It may have been deleted on another device.
postponeBody: Nothing is lost. It comes back at the time you pick.
postponeCustomWhen: Pick the day and the hour
confirmDropBody: It stays in your history. This is a decision, not a failure.
confirmDeleteBody: It leaves your lists for good. Dropping it on purpose keeps it in your history instead.
evidenceShortForEndOfDay: short enough for the end of the day
evidenceFitsBeforeDue: there is time before it is due
evidenceUsualProductiveTime: a time you usually get things done
nextStepNoSensitive: Only your own commitments, deadlines and routine were used.
nextStepEmptyBody: There is nothing open that needs a decision right now.
nextStepThinBody: Add a time or say how much something matters, and there will be something to suggest.
nextStepStale: That one moved. Here is the current suggestion.
evidenceFitsFocusTime: in a time you set aside to focus
captureAiOffHint: Understood by rules on our server. Tap to change.
captureDiscardBody: What you typed is only here. Closing forgets it.
captureClipboardBody: Read from your clipboard just now, because you asked. Nothing is sent anywhere until you understand it.
captureClipboardReplaces: This replaces what’s already in the field.
captureClipboardEmptyBody: There’s no text on your clipboard right now.
reviewNothingSelected: Nothing selected. Pick at least one.
savedFailedBody: These stayed out of your day. You can say them again.
rowActionsHint: Swipe for done and not now
flagDisabled: Feedback isn’t being collected right now.
historyDecisionsEmpty: Nothing yet. Your answers to suggestions show here.
activityWeekDone: {n, plural, =0{Nothing finished yet} one{You finished one thing} other{You finished # things}}
activityWeekPlanned: {n, plural, =0{No days with a plan} one{One day with a plan} other{# days with a plan}}
activityWeekKept: {n, plural, =0{Nothing kept yet} one{You kept one thing you said matters} other{You kept # things you said matter}}
activityEmpty: Nothing here yet. What you capture and finish shows up here.
activityUnavailable: We can't reach your activity right now. Nothing changed.
shareNothingSentYet: Nothing has left your phone yet. Read it over first.
shareUnavailable: Sharing into MaybeSitter isn’t switched on yet. Nothing was sent.
shareTooLarge: That’s too big to send. Share a smaller part of it.
shareUnsupported: MaybeSitter can’t read that kind of file yet.
shareImageUnreadable: MaybeSitter couldn’t open that picture, so nothing was sent. Take a screenshot of it and share the screenshot instead.
shareTooManyFiles: Too many files at once. Share up to five images, or one file.
shareTextTooLong: That’s a lot of text. Share a shorter part of it.
shareEmpty: There was nothing in that to read.
shareNeedsAi: Reading a picture or a file needs the AI turned on. Nothing was sent.
planNothingPlaced: Nothing is placed at a time today.
planRemovedItem: This is no longer on your list.
planRegenerateLeft: {n, plural, one{One more today} other{# more today}}
planRegenerateNoneLeft: You've asked for a new plan as often as you can today. Tomorrow starts fresh.
planEmptyBody: Build it now, or turn the morning plan on and we'll lay your day out each morning.
planEmptyBodyReady: Today's plan hasn't been built yet. Build it now and we'll lay your day out.
planOfflineCold: No internet, so today's plan isn't here yet.
planOfflineReadOnly: No internet. This is the plan as it was; nothing changes until you're back.
planReasonNoRoom: There was no free stretch long enough today.
planReasonCalendarBusy: The time it needs is already taken.
planReasonWaiting: It waits on something else that has no place today.
planReasonNoLength: We don't know yet how long it takes.
planReasonClockChange: The clock moved that night, so its time is unclear.
planEditOutsideDay: That time is outside today. It stayed where it was.
planEditOutsideHours: That time is outside the hours this plan uses. It stayed where it was.
planEditBusy: That time is already taken. It stayed where it was.
planEditOverlaps: Something else is at that time. It stayed where it was.
planEditGone: This is no longer in today's plan.
planEditUnclear: That time didn't work. It stayed where it was.
planMorningBody: Each morning we lay your day out and send one note when it's ready. You decide what to do with it.
planCardPlaced: {n, plural, =0{Nothing needed a time today} one{One thing placed today} other{# things placed today}}
calendarWriteToggle: Add my commitments to my calendar
calendarWriteBody: Every commitment you confirm that has a time is added to a calendar you choose. Editing or deleting it here moves or removes the event too. Only the title and the time are written.
calendarWriteUnavailable: Calendar writing is switched off in this build.
calendarPermissionDenied: MaybeSitter does not have access to your calendar, so nothing can be added. Your phone only asks once — you can turn it on in Settings.
calendarPickBody: Events go here. Pick the one you want other people to see, or one only you read.
calendarNoneWritable: No calendar on this phone can be written to.
calendarRemoveBody: Removes only the events MaybeSitter added. Anything you put in your calendar yourself is untouched.
calendarRemoveDone: Removed. Your own entries were not touched.
footballBody: Follow the clubs you care about, and their matches go straight onto your calendar — two hours, kickoff to final whistle.
footballSaveFailed: Couldn’t save your clubs. Check your connection and tap again.
calendarBusyConflictAllDay: Your calendar has an all-day entry that day
calendarReadBody: MaybeSitter reads when you are busy — the times only, never what the events are called. It plans around them and tells you when something you are about to save overlaps one.
calendarReadUnavailable: Reading your calendar is switched off in this build.
calendarDisconnectBody: Stops reading your calendar, deletes the busy times from this phone and removes them from your account.
calendarDisconnectDone: Disconnected. The busy times are gone from this phone and from your account.
calendarDisconnectFailed: They were removed from this phone. Your account still has them — try again when you are back online.
calendarDeclinedNote: On Android a meeting you declined still counts as busy: the phone does not tell us whose reply was whose.
catSettingsBody: Sort your commitments into parts of your life, and filter your lists by them. Off by default: everything stays in one list.
catSettingsSplitHint: Adds a row of filters above your lists.
catSettingsWhichHint: Only the ones you keep are used. Turn off the ones that are not part of your life.
catSettingsNone: You have turned off every category, so nothing will be sorted.
catSaveFailed: Could not save that. Try again.
widgetShowTitles: Show titles on the home screen widget
widgetShowTitlesBody: Off by default. Anyone who picks up your phone can see the home screen, so the widget says “Private commitment” with the time and how much it matters. Turn this on to show the real titles on the home screen. The lock screen never shows them, and iOS hides them whenever the phone is locked.
widgetSaveFailed: Could not save that on this phone. Try again.
icsFeedsIntro: Paste your university's calendar link once. Deadlines come in as suggestions you keep or skip, and lectures count as busy time.
icsFeedsHelp: In Moodle: Calendar → Export → Get calendar URL.
icsFeedsAutoAcceptBody: Off: each deadline waits for you. On: it becomes a commitment straight away, and you can undo it.
icsFeedsPrivacy: The link works like a password. It is saved encrypted, and this app never shows it again.
icsFeedsConsentBody: To add a calendar link, allow MaybeSitter to use your calendar. You can turn it off any time.
icsFeedsUnavailable: Calendar links are not available in this version.
icsFeedsRemoveConfirm: Remove this link? Its busy times and waiting deadlines go. Commitments you kept stay.
icsFeedsBanner: We haven't been able to read one of your calendar links for a while. Nothing is lost — try refreshing it, or remove it and add it again.
icsFeedsStatusPaused: Paused while calendar use is off
icsFeedsAutoAdded: Added for you from the calendar
icsFeedsRemovedFromSource: The calendar no longer has this. Your commitment stays.
icsFeedsErrInvalidUrl: That isn't a calendar link we can use. Copy the export link again, exactly as Moodle shows it.
icsFeedsErrNotCalendar: That link opened, but there's no calendar in it. Check you copied the export link.
icsFeedsErrFetch: We couldn't open that link. Check it's right and try again.
icsFeedsErrTooComplex: That calendar is too big or complicated to read.
icsFeedsErrTooMany: You can have up to five calendar links. Remove one to add another.
icsFeedsErrTooSoon: It was just refreshed. Try again in a few minutes.
icsFeedsErrChanged: This changed in the meantime. Here is how it looks now.
icsFeedsErrUnavailable: Calendar links can't be saved right now. Try again later.
langHint: You can change this later in Settings.
obSetupPlaceholder: Or say it in your own words
obSetupDayPrompt: What does a typical day look like for you?
obSetupDonePrompt: Something you finished lately, big or small?
obSetupHabitsPrompt: Habits you keep, or want to keep?
obSetupHabitsChip1: Exercise a few times a week
obSetupLifeTitle: Let me get to know you a little
obSetupLifeBody: Tell me about your life right now — what you do with your days, what you're trying to balance, and what takes up most of your time.
obSetupLifeHelper: No need to organise it. Say it the way you'd tell someone who knows you.
obSetupLifePlaceholder: For example: I'm a student and I also work evenings. I have university a few days a week, I'm trying to find time for the gym and for a project that matters to me, and there's often so much going on I don't know where to start…
obSetupLifePrompt1: What do you do with your days?
obSetupLifePrompt2: What matters most to you right now?
obSetupLifePrompt3: What takes most of your time?
obSetupLifePrompt4: What do you always try not to forget?
